what: When the plate opens (is-open), eight cloud blobs staggered behind it swell from 0 to 2x over 2s ease (delayed .1·.3·.15·.3·.25·.2·.15·.4s respectively) and melt together through a gooey filter (blur 30 + alpha ×20 −7, blur 5px again), filling the plate like a cloud. On close they shrink in .5s — the menu drawer clears all at once with no delay on 1s cubic-bezier(.1,.8,.6,.8). With ‹on: view› it is a label background that opens each time it enters the screen and closes when it leaves

options.on: ”view” adds is-open when entering the screen band (margin) and removes it when leaving. Without it, the user side adds and removes is-open (menu drawer)
options.repeat: on: view — when set to ”off” it opens only once
options.look: ”large” uses the filter for large panels (blur 70 + 20px), ”reverse” starts covered and clears over 1.5s when opened
options.--fx-cols: Grid cell count (via style), default 2 — 3 for wide panels
options.--fx-close-dur: Closing duration (via style), default .5s — the original menu drawer uses 1s
options.--fx-close-ease: Closing curve (via style), default ease — the original menu drawer uses cubic-bezier(.1,.8,.6,.8)
options.--fx-close-lag: Closing delay multiplier (set via style), default 1 — 0 closes everything at once
options.--fx-z: Cloud layer z-index (via style), default 0 — panel content sits above it
options.[data-fx-part=cloud]: Cloud layer (created if missing — clumps <i> fills)
